A calm, private place to set your worries down, and see how many of them actually happened.
Everything stays in a file on your computer. No account, no internet.

## Download
| System | File |
|---|---|
| **Windows 10/11** | `Pebble_…_x64-setup.exe` (recommended) or `Pebble_…_x64_en-US.msi` |
| **macOS** (Apple Silicon and Intel) | `Pebble_…_universal.dmg` |
| **Linux** | `.deb` (Ubuntu, Debian), `.rpm` (Fedora), or `.AppImage` (any distribution: make it executable, then run) |

## First launch
Pebble isn't code-signed yet, so your system asks before opening it the first time:
- **macOS:** open the `.dmg`, drag Pebble to Applications, then right-click Pebble → **Open** → **Open**. On recent macOS you may instead need System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway**.
- **Windows:** on "Windows protected your PC", choose **More info** → **Run anyway**.
